title: Workday HCM - HR Cloud Operate
description:
**Position Summary**
**Human Capital**
The Human Capital Offering Portfolio focuses on helping organizations manage and sustain their performance through their most important asset: their people. Centered on five core issues, this Portfolio signifies to the market that we see Human Capital as a topic critical to the C-Suite. As we go-to-market we will show our clients that we serve more than HR organizations – from the CEO to CFO, Risk Manager to Business Unit leader—and that we deliver on our issues and help create value for our clients.
  
  
****Position Summary****
**Level:**
Consultant
  
  
As an experienced Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will be responsible for individually delivering high quality work products within due timelines. Need-basis you will be mentoring and/or directing junior team members/liaising with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements .
  
  
**Work you’ll do:**

* Our practitioners will be able to maintain the specialization they have built to date in certain areas while also learning how it connects to broader issues in the market.
* We are committed to continuously supporting our practitioners as they build skills in either one specific part of our business or across the business – our Portfolio is structured to facilitate this learning.
* With Human Capital at the forefront of every organization and Industry, our people will have the ability to capitalize on some of the biggest trends happening today and support organizations working to leverage their greatest asset: their people.
* We will continue to help our people deliver world-class services, innovate on new solutions and products, and prepare them to address our clients’ most difficult challenges in the market.

**The Team:**
Our
**Insights, Innovation & Operate Offering**
is designed to enhance key aspects of our clients' businesses by leveraging cutting-edge technology, data, and a blend of deep technical and human expertise. We innovate and deliver creative, industry-specific solutions that streamline operations and accelerate speed-to-value.
  
  
****Qualifications****
**Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* 3 - 6 years of hands-on experience
* Certification: Must have active Workday Certification

**Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**
**Key Skills - For Functional Role**

* Must have active Workday Certification
* Workday Implementation/Support experience of at least two projects.
* 3 -6 years of experience in Workday Core HCM, Core & Advance Compensation, Talent & Performance Management, Recruiting, Prism Analytics, Payroll, Benefits, Learning, Absence Management & Time Tracking.
* Experience in HR processes and should have worked on two or more projects in a functional capacity on above mentioned modules.
* Understanding of any industry would be a plus
* Excellent Communication Skills

**Key Skills - For Integration Role**

* Must have active Workday Certification
* Workday – EIB, Studio, PECI, WECI Document Transformation, Core HCM / Benefits / Payroll Connectors, Calculated Fields, XSLT / XML, Web Services API
* Should have experience in designing and developing EIB’s, Studio, xslt , DT, PECI
* Should have the ability to have design discussions with the client
* Ability to code, write design / technical specifications, perform code reviews, understand integration strategies, understand how HR interfaces with other modules
* Excellent Communication Skills

**Key Skills - For Conversion Role**

* Must have active Workday Certification
* Should have experience in handling the end to end conversions for at least two large Workday projects
* Must have handled the ETL for two projects
* Ability to handle the mapping discussions between the client stake holders
* Should have the ability to propose the number of prototypes needed for a client
* Excellent Communication Skills

**Education:**

* BE/ B.Tech /M.C.A./ M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university

**Location:**

* Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai/Kolkata

title: Human Resources Executive
description:
**Company Description:**
Brandwise Events & Experience, founded in 2010, specializes in creating impactful brand experiences through events and experiential marketing by combining ideas with technology. The company has grown into a trusted partner and an extension of its clients’ teams, known for practical, high-impact experiential projects and continuous learning.

**Role Description:**
The Human Resources Executive role is a full-time, on-site position based in Chennai. This role involves managing day-to-day HR operations, including employee onboarding, documentation, and maintaining HR records.

**Qualifications**

* Strong foundation in Human Resources (HR) and HR Management, with the ability to support overall people strategies and processes.
* Hands-on experience in HR Operations, including recruitment coordination, onboarding, HR documentation, and HRIS or HR-related systems.
* Proficiency in Employee Relations, including conflict resolution, grievance handling, and supporting employee engagement initiatives.
* Ability to understand, implement, and maintain HR Policies, ensuring compliance with relevant labor laws and organizational standards.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with diverse teams and stakeholders.

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; professional HR certifications are an advantage.
* Prior experience in the events, marketing, or hospitality industry is beneficial.

title: People Consulting-Payroll-Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY- GDS India – People Consulting, Payroll – Senior Consultant**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are looking for Senior Consultants with expertise in Payroll to join the People Consulting team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be a part of a leading global professional services organisation whilst being instrumental in the growth of the People Consulting team.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Leverage experience in the payroll domain to deliver Payroll transformation programs for global clients, in collaboration with other GDS teams and EY member firms
* Work on global client projects as part of a globally distributed, multidisciplinary team. Ensure quality, timeliness, accuracy, and compliance of all deliverables
* Provide domain expertise across multiple Payroll service areas such as Payroll Inputs, Gross-to-Net processing, Payroll remittances, Statutory compliance, Garnishments, Workforce management, and post-payroll reporting
* Be recognised as a subject matter expert in one or more areas of the Payroll domain
* Support development of thought leadership, collateral, tools, accelerators, methodologies and assets to enhance payroll advisory and broader workforce capability offerings within the practice
* Support design and build of AI / GenAI / Agentic AI proof-of-concepts, accelerators, and automation use cases within the Payroll practice
* Drive effective client communication and delivery cadence; build strong relationships with clients and project counterparts across global locations. Proactively manage risks and ensure excellent client and stakeholder feedback

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* High integrity, strong work ethic, and commitment to thriving in a dynamic and evolving environment
* Ability to manage ambiguity, demonstrate structured problem-solving, and proactively identify improvement opportunities
* Strong communication, storytelling, and presentation skills (written and verbal)
* Cross-cultural awareness and ability to work effectively across geographies and time zones
* High energy levels, agility, adaptability, and continuous learning mindset
* Open to national and international travel for client engagements as approved under EY and country-specific travel advisory guidelines

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 5–9 years of experience in Payroll consulting and/or payroll operations
* Minimum 2 years of experience in global payroll advisory or global payroll delivery models
* Master’s degree in Finance / HR or full-time MBA
* Hands-on experience delivering payroll implementation, transformation or optimization programs as part of a global distributed team
* Prior experience working in a consulting or professional services environment
* Strong understanding of one or more payroll technology platforms such as ADP, SAP, Workday, PeopleSoft, Oracle or equivalent systems

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Strong technical knowledge of end-to-end payroll processes, controls, and downstream integrations
* Strong analytical skills along with proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and Word; exposure to data analytics and dashboarding tools is an advantage
* Experience in process mapping and documentation using Visio or equivalent process design tools
* Expertise in creating SOPs, global process documentation, work instructions, and control narratives
* Active involvement in end-to-end payroll implementation, transformation, or stabilization programs
* Exposure to workforce or HR transformation initiatives enabled by cloud and digital technologies
* Experience in policy reviews, current-state payroll assessments, vendor evaluations and selections, global payroll process design, and implementation support
* Hands-on experience in payroll automation initiatives including RPA, workflow automation, and exception management
* Working knowledge of global payroll platforms such as ADP (GlobalView, Workforce Now), SAP, Workday, Oracle/PeopleSoft products, with participation in multi–workstream global transformation programs
* FPC, CPP, PMP or other payroll related certifications will be an added advantage
* Experience working closely with global payroll vendors such as ADP, SAP, Workday and third-party payroll providers

**What We Look For**

* Professionals who are independent, self-motivated, proactive, results-oriented and able to provide a high level of customer satisfaction through the delivery of world-class support services. Apart from day-to-day activities, the candidate is expected to be involved in strategic planning to grow the team.
* Technical experts with commercial acumen, relevant experiences and high degree of enthusiasm to adapt and learn in a fast-moving environment.
* Professionals who are willing to work in an environment of continual professional development, drive to take on new responsibilities and projects and work experiences with clients across geographies.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment**
: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development**
: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture**
: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply**
: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

As a global manufacturer of Electrical Safety, Reliability, and Asset Monitoring solutions, IRISS is growing its India presence through a new manufacturing facility in Chennai and a Sales & Distribution office in Bangalore.

This is an opportunity to build the people practices, leadership capabilities, and workplace infrastructure that will support our next phase of growth.

The Opportunity

You will lead HR and Administration across our India Manufacturing and Sales/ Distribution Operations, partnering with local and global leadership to build a high-performing organization and support broader APAC priorities.

Combining strategic leadership with hands-on execution, you will help attract the right talent, develop effective leaders, strengthen employee relations, and establish consistent, scalable HR practices across manufacturing and commercial teams.

Your Impact

Build the workforce: Lead workforce planning and recruitment across production, technical, supervisory, engineering, sales, and support functions.

Establish the foundation: Develop and implement HR policies, systems, onboarding, and processes that support a growing manufacturing and sales/ distribution organization.

Strengthen employee relations: Build trust, coach managers, and manage grievances, disciplinary matters, safety, training, and industrial relations with fairness and sound judgment.

Lead compliance: Oversee applicable labour and employment requirements, factory-related HR compliance, statutory filings, employee records, and audit readiness.

Develop talent and leadership: Drive performance management, learning, career development, and succession planning.

Support accurate payroll: Maintain reliable payroll inputs, employee data, and HR documentation in partnership with payroll and finance.

Run effective workplaces: Oversee facilities administration, security, housekeeping, service providers, vendor contracts, and related budgets across Chennai and Bangalore.

Inform business decisions: Use workforce data to identify risks, improve retention, and align people priorities with operational needs.

What You Bring

MBA/PGDM in Human Resources, Personnel Management, Labour Welfare, or a related discipline.

At least 12 years of progressive HR experience, including fast growing manufacturing and corporate environments and responsibility for HR leadership.

Strong working knowledge of Indian labour laws, statutory requirements, factory compliance, and industrial relations.

Experience building or scaling HR practices in a growing organization; new facility setup experience is highly desirable.

Ability to support both factory employees and sales/commercial teams.

Strong communication, stakeholder management, and change leadership skills.

A practical, accountable approach and the confidence to work closely with global leadership. Broader APAC experience is an advantage.

What Success Looks Like

A capable workforce hired against business priorities. Effective onboarding and performance management. Timely statutory compliance and payroll inputs. Strong employee relations, improved retention, and well-managed facilities within budget.

Why IRISS?

Build and lead a function with meaningful business impact, direct exposure to global leadership, and the opportunity to shape our growing India operations. Ready to help build what comes next?

title: Recruiting Solutions
description:
At U.S. Bancorp India, we’re on a journey to do our best. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bancorp India gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Recruiting Solutions Project Manager, U.S. Bancorp India**
The Recruiting Solutions Project Manager will support the U.S. Bancorp India Global Capability Center recruiting organization by enabling effective, compliant, and scalable recruiting operations across India. This position will play a central role in preparing and supporting recruiters through training, process and technology enhancements, change management, communications, risk and compliance coordination, and knowledge base management.
  
  
The Recruiting Solutions Project Manager will partner with the India recruiting team, Global Enterprise Recruiting Solutions team, HR Product and Engineering, Legal, Risk, and other key stakeholders to ensure recruiting processes and technology meet local business requirements, support a consistent recruiter and candidate experience, and are successfully adopted by the recruiting organization.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and support recruiting operations, process, training, and technology initiatives for the U.S. Bancorp India GCC recruiting organization.
* Develop and deliver recruiter training, tools, job aids, and other enablement resources that strengthen recruiter readiness, process adherence, and operational consistency.
* Assess recruiter training needs and translate new or changing processes, policies, and technology capabilities into practical learning materials and communications.
* Partner with HR Product and Engineering teams to identify, document, prioritize, and track recruiting product enhancement requests based on India business and recruiter needs.
* Coordinate and participate in user acceptance testing and post-implementation validation and hyper care for recruiting tools and system changes.
* Identify technology defects, process gaps, and user experience issues, document findings and partner with product team and vendors through resolution.
* Partner with Legal, Risk, Compliance, and other subject matter experts to ensure India recruiting processes, procedures, communications, and technology configurations align with applicable laws, regulatory expectations, company policies, and established controls.
* Develop and deliver appropriate change management, communication, training, and adoption plans in response to recruiting process, policy, and technology changes
* Monitor adoption of new recruiting processes and tools, gather feedback from users, identify barriers, and recommend actions to strengthen adoption and effectiveness.
* Maintain India recruiting knowledge base content and ensure materials remain accurate, current, accessible, and aligned with global standards and local requirements.
* Serve as a resource for India recruiters and recruiting leaders by addressing questions, identifying appropriate referrals, and supporting resolution of complex process and technology issues.
* Leverage recruiter feedback, operational data, testing results, and adoption insights to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Build strong partnerships across India recruiting, Global Enterprise Recruiting, HR Product and Engineering, Legal, Risk, and other cross-functional teams to drive alignment and successful delivery in a matrixed environment.
* Act as a recruiting operations and enablement subject matter expert by maintaining awareness of evolving business needs, India recruiting practices, technology capabilities, and industry trends.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent work experience.
* Five years of experience in recruiting operations, recruiting, change management, HR technology, learning and development, or a related field.

**Preferred Skills/Experience**

* Demonstrated experience supporting recruiting operations, recruiter enablement, HR technology, process improvement, or large-scale organizational change.
* Experience developing and facilitating recruiter training, process education, job aids, presentations, and other enablement materials.
* Knowledge of recruiting processes and technology, preferably including Workday Recruiting, Phenom, or comparable applicant tracking and candidate relationship management platforms.
* Experience gathering and documenting business requirements, enhancement requests, use cases, testing scenarios, and acceptance criteria.
* Experience supporting user acceptance testing, defect documentation, issue resolution, and implementation of HR or recruiting technology.
* Understanding of India recruitment practices, employment-related compliance requirements, and the importance of partnering with Legal and Risk to translate requirements into practical recruiting procedures.
* Experience developing communications and change management plans that support successful adoption of new processes, policies, and technology.
* Strong technical writing and process documentation skills, including the ability to create clear knowledge articles, standard operating procedures, process guides, and user-facing instructions.
* Ability to synthesize complex policy, legal, risk, process, and technology information into clear and actionable guidance for recruiters.
* Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives, priorities, stakeholders, and deadlines.
* Innovative, resourceful, solutions-oriented, and committed to identifying opportunities to improve recruiting processes, workflows, user experience, and operational efficiency.
* Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills, including the ability to influence without authority and work effectively across global and cross-functional teams.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, presentation skills, and attention to detail.
* Ability to work effectively across India and U.S. time zones when collaboration with global stakeholders is required.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint; working knowledge of recruiting reporting, metrics, and analytics is preferred.

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate a disability during any portion of the application or hiring process, please refer to our disability accommodations for applicants.

title: Associate Director
description:
**About Taggd**

Taggd is a digital recruitment platform that provides Ready-to-Hire talent to India Inc. Combining human knowledge and data, we have fulfilled talent mandates for 100+ clients and ensured hiring manager success for half a million jobs across 14+ sectors. Our vision is to fulfil 1 million jobs through our talent platform by 2030.

**Role Snapshot**

* **Designation:**
  Associate Director – Talent Solutions
* **Location:**
  Chennai
* **Industry Focus:**
  Manufacturing / Automobile
* **Reports to:**
  Senior Director – Talent Solutions
* **Team Span:**
  30+ recruiters
* **Hiring Volume:**
  1,000–1,500 hires annually across multiple business functions
* **Experience:**
  13+ years in recruitment or RPO, including 6–8 years leading a team

**About the Role**

Own the end-to-end talent acquisition mandate for an assigned manufacturing or automotive account. You will deliver the annual hiring plan to SLA, protect account revenue, and build a recruitment team that consistently meets its targets.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Delivery and Operations*

* Deliver the annual hiring plan of 1,000–1,500 hires, tracked as monthly fulfilment against plan (target: 95%+)
* Keep time-to-fill within the contracted SLA for each role band and review every requisition ageing beyond 30 days in the weekly account review
* Track funnel ratios weekly (CV-to-shortlist, shortlist-to-interview, interview-to-offer) and act on any stage below benchmark
* Maintain offer-to-join conversion at 85% or above through structured candidate engagement
* Publish a weekly dashboard covering open positions, ageing, pipeline health, SLA status and offers in hand
* Own account revenue against the annual plan, including billing accuracy and on-time collections
* Ensure 100% ATS data accuracy with same-day candidate status updates

*Sourcing and Talent Pipeline*

* Lead hands-on sourcing for critical and niche mandates and head-hunt for roles portals cannot fill
* Build ready pipelines of active and passive candidates for repeat-demand and hard-to-fill roles
* Introduce at least one new sourcing channel or campaign format each quarter and report its yield
* Complete skill and sub-skill mapping for 100% of active requisitions

*Client and Stakeholder Governance*

* Run weekly requisition reviews with hiring managers and monthly and quarterly business reviews with client leadership
* Act as the single point of contact for all recruitment, sourcing and escalation matters on the account
* Share market intelligence (talent availability, compensation trends, competitor movement) in every monthly review
* Measure hiring manager CSAT each quarter and close every feedback item with a documented action

*Technology and AI Adoption*

* Drive full team adoption of AI-enabled tools for campaign creation, sourcing, screening and candidate engagement
* Ensure governance and compliance with zero audit exceptions on the account

*People Management*

* Create KPIs for every team member on the HRMS and manage performance through the year
* Share the quarterly scorecard with the Performance Management team on time
* Run structured engagement and team-bonding connects, and build a documented career path for each team member
* Plan and track training; hold voluntary attrition at or below 15%

**What We’re Looking For**

* 13+ years in recruitment or RPO delivery, of which 6–8 years leading a recruitment team through an annual hiring plan
* Volume hiring experience in manufacturing or automotive, with a clear view of where the talent sits, what it costs and why offers fall through (mandatory requirement)
* Ability to hold your own with business heads and CHRO-level stakeholders and challenge unrealistic briefs with data
* Hands-on sourcing skills: head-hunting, Boolean and advanced search, portals and professional networks
* Strong funnel analysis: spot a failing stage early, explain the cause and act on it
* Comfort with AI-enabled sourcing tools (CV matching, Gen AI Boolean strings and adverts, automated outreach) and measuring what each one yields
* Ability to run the weekly delivery dashboard and monthly account MIS, and act on what the numbers show
* Skill in building recruiter capability: identify gaps, coach and add capability where needed
* Ownership of the measures the client judges the account on: hiring plan fulfilment, TAT and SLA management
* Graduate in any discipline; MBA/PGDM in HR preferred

title: GCC Demand Management & Planning Lead
description:
**Job Description**

**Role Summary-**

The GCC Demand Management & Planning Lead is responsible for managing the complete process of identifying, approving, planning, and fulfilling business demands for SMBC Global Services (GCC) in India.

The role serves as the main point of contact between regional business teams and GCC teams, ensuring that requests for new roles, additional headcount, and business support services are properly documented, approved, and executed in line with the organization’s growth plans and governance standards.

The individual will work closely with business leaders, HR, Talent Acquisition, Finance, Risk, Compliance, and other functional teams to coordinate workforce planning, recruitment, approvals, and transition activities. The role also involves managing project timelines, tracking progress, resolving issues, maintaining governance documentation, and ensuring that new services are transitioned to the GCC smoothly and efficiently.

**Key Responsibilities**
-

1. Demand Intake and Requirement Gathering

· Act as the main contact for regional teams requesting new roles or additional resources in the GCC.

· Understand the business need, required headcount, job responsibilities, and hiring priorities.

· Ensure all requests have the necessary information and business justification.

· Maintain a central tracker to monitor all incoming requests and their progress.

2. Demand Governance and Approvals

· Track each request through the required approval process.

· Ensure all necessary regional approvals and supporting documents are available before recruitment begins.

· Maintain proper records and evidence for audits and governance reviews.

· Follow up on pending approvals and escalate delays or missing documentation.

3. Job Description and Requisition Management

· Work with business stakeholders to prepare and improve job descriptions.

· Ensure job descriptions meet GCC requirements and organizational standards.

· Prepare job requisition forms based on approved job descriptions.

· Coordinate internal approvals so that recruitment can begin on time.

4. Recruitment Coordination and Tracking

· Monitor the recruitment progress of all approved positions.

· Work with HR and Talent Acquisition teams to track vacancies, interviews, and hiring status.

· Identify recruitment delays and coordinate with the relevant teams to resolve them.

· Participate in hiring discussions and recruitment review meetings.

5. Stakeholder Management and Communication

· Build strong working relationships with regional business teams and GCC stakeholders.

· Organize regular meetings to review demand, approvals, recruitment progress, and outstanding issues.

· Provide regular status updates to management and stakeholders.

· Identify risks, issues, and dependencies early and ensure appropriate follow-up.

6. Workforce Planning and Continuous Improvement

· Support workforce planning and GCC expansion across technology, operations, and corporate functions.

· Analyze demand trends and provide reports to help management make informed decisions.

· Improve demand management processes, governance standards, and reporting methods.

· Coordinate with Corporate Function leaders to support Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) assessments.

·Collect and consolidate documents and evidence required for TPRM reviews.

· Track outstanding TPRM actions and ensure requests from regional and governance teams are addressed on time.

7. Cross-Functional Coordination

· Manage demand requests across HR, Treasury, Compliance, Risk Management, Data, Finance, Operations, and other corporate functions.

· Work with subject matter experts to understand the requirements of different roles and business areas.

· Ensure consistent processes, documentation, approvals, and recruitment practices across all functions.

8. Project Management and Reporting

· Manage the overall plan for demand-related initiatives, including timelines, milestones, deliverables, and dependencies.

· Lead coordination meetings, governance forums, and weekly status reviews.

· Work with multiple teams, including regional stakeholders, GCC, HR, Finance, Risk, Compliance, and Technology.

· Prepare weekly reports, dashboards, action trackers, risk logs, and decision records.

· Ensure activities are completed within agreed timelines and that stakeholders remain informed.

9. Transition Management and Operational Readiness

· Coordinate the complete transition process when a new role, function, or service moves to the GCC.

· Manage activities from initial demand approval and recruitment through knowledge transfer, operational readiness, stabilization, and final handover.

· Prepare transition plans, readiness checklists, timelines, and dependency trackers.

· Identify potential transition risks and resolve gaps before they affect delivery.

· Ensure the GCC is ready to take ownership of new services and operate them effectively.

title: Director- Performance and Business Management
description:
Job Title: Director of Performance and Business Management
  
  
GCL: F
  
  
**Introduction To Role**
Are you ready to turn strategy into measurable outcomes that accelerate a data-powered enterprise? This role develops how we plan, measure, and guide one of AstraZeneca’s most critical global capabilities. It ensures ambitious ambitions turn into clear results that benefit individuals and the business. ness.
  
  
As Director of Performance and Business Management, you will lead the performance framework, scorecards and executive insight that guide the Global Data Office (GDO), while building the operating rhythm and business management disciplines that keep delivery sharp and accountable. With a focus split roughly 60% on performance management and insight and 40% on business management and operating effectiveness, you will give leaders the clarity to act with confidence—on outcomes, risks and value. Can you create the management system that turns strategy into disciplined execution across a sophisticated, global matrix?
  
  
You will report to the Senior Director, Data Strategy and Performance and work closely with GDO leaders, enterprise partners and service owners to align strategic priorities with operational execution. Your impact will be felt in the everyday decisions leaders make, the speed at which we move, and the value we deliver across the enterprise.
  
  
**Accountabilities**
Performance Framework Leadership: Convert strategy into quantifiable goals and results; build and evolve the GDO performance framework to provide trusted management insight.
  
  
Executive Scorecards and KPIs: Own and refine the benchmark framework and executive scorecards to emphasize value, customer outcomes, delivery health and strategic priorities—not activity alone.
  
  
Leadership Performance Reviews: Lead performance reviews for the GDO Leadership Team, surfacing trends, risks, dependencies and opportunities to drive clear decisions and actions.
  
  
Benefits Realisation and Value Tracking: Establish consistent approaches to value tracking across programmes, services and data products, ensuring benefits are quantified and realised.
  
  
Reporting and Automation: Define future reporting requirements and coordinate enhancements to Keystone and related performance reporting for improved quality, usability, automation and insight.
  
  
Operating Rhythm and Planning: Coordinate the annual planning cycle and operating rhythm, including Leadership Team secretariat, quarterly performance assessments, medium-term planning and follow-through.
  
  
Strategic Alignment and Governance: Drive alignment between GDO priorities and the plans of enterprise partners, preserving clear accountability for delivery within each function.
  
  
Operating Model Transparency: Clarify accountabilities across vertical and horizontal teams, including service ownership, interfaces, decision rights, governance and RACIs.
  
  
Collaborator and Partner Experience: Develop proportionate collaborator experience measures that inform decisions, using feedback mechanisms where they add tangible value.
  
  
Strategic Communications Partnership: Partner with Communications to translate strategy, performance and priorities into clear internal communications, while maintaining functional accountability.
  
  
Governance and Customer Forums: Support relevant forums to align priorities, review performance and resolve cross-functional issues, while not taking direct responsibility for external customer boards.
  
  
Strategic Partner to Leadership: Provide constructive challenge, data-driven insight and focused execution support to the GDO Leadership Team.
  
  
People Leadership: Lead and develop direct or matrix team members, fostering clarity, accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.
  
  
**Essential Skills/Experience**

* Significant senior leadership experience in performance management, strategy, transformation, business management or interpersonal effectiveness within a sophisticated global organisation.
* Demonstrated experience leading long-term planning, benchmark and scorecard development, executive performance reporting and benefits realisation.
* Consistent record to establish operating rhythms, governance, decision rights, RACIs and accountability across matrix teams.
* Strong analytical and storytelling skills, proficient in translating sophisticated information into clear executive insight, decisions and action.
* Excellent collaborator management, influencing and facilitation skills, including capacity to build alignment across interpersonal boundaries without assuming ownership for others’ delivery.
* Experience coordinating annual planning, quarterly business reviews and medium-term planning processes.
* Ability to simplify approaches to work, resolve ambiguity and drive follow-through in a fast paced environment.
* Demonstrated leadership capability and dedication to inclusion, cooperation, and ongoing improvement.
* Experience in data, analytics, digital, technology, pharmaceutical or shared-services environments.
* Understanding of enterprise data operating models, service management and the relationship between vertical business ownership and horizontal capabilities.
* Experience with employee evaluation systems, reporting automation and collaborator experience measurement.
* Experience partnering with Communications and People teams on strategic engagement, while maintaining clear functional accountability.

**Desirable Skills/Experience**

* Experience operating in global data and analytics leadership roles within life sciences or other highly supervised industries.
* Familiarity with Keystone or comparable enterprise performance management platforms and automation toolchains.
* Consistent record introducing benefits realisation frameworks and value measurement for data products and shared services.
* Sophisticated training or certification in strategy execution, interpersonal performance oversight, operating model development or portfolio management.
* Experience crafting and implementing proportionate user experience metrics for internal services, such as NPS/CES, in contexts that chip in decision value.

across business operations. The successful candidate should be capable of identifying attrition drivers, developing effective retention strategies, and partnering with operations leaders to improve employee experience and workforce stability.

* Develop proactive retention plans for critical talent, high-performing employees, and key operational teams.
* Conduct exit interviews, stay interviews, employee feedback sessions, and attrition analysis to identify underlying concerns and recommend sustainable solutions.
* Work closely with people managers to strengthen leadership effectiveness, address employee concerns, and improve team engagement and retention.
* Act as a strategic HR advisor on workforce planning, organizational development, employee engagement, performance management, and people-related business challenges.
* Drive employee relations initiatives, grievance management, disciplinary processes, and conflict resolution in line with company policies and applicable employment regulations.
* Lead talent management, succession planning, leadership development, and performance management initiatives.
* Develop and implement employee engagement, recognition, career development, and culture-building initiatives to improve employee satisfaction and retention.
* Analyse HR metrics, including attrition rates, retention trends, absenteeism, employee engagement, and workforce productivity, to support data-driven decision-making.
* Partner with Talent Acquisition and business leaders to address workforce requirements, critical hiring needs, and workforce planning challenges.
* Drive change management, organizational restructuring, and people transformation initiatives.
* Ensure HR policies, processes, and practices comply with applicable labour laws, statutory requirements, and organizational standards.
* Collaborate with HR Centres of Excellence, including Talent Acquisition, Learning & Development, Compensation & Benefits, and HR Operations, to deliver effective HR solutions.
* Lead and mentor HR Business Partners and HR teams, fostering accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Prepare and present HR dashboards, attrition reports, retention metrics, business reviews, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership.
* Support business expansion, employee productivity, and organizational effectiveness through proactive HR interventions.

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* MBA, MSW, or postgraduate qualification in Human Resources preferred.
* 15+ years of overall HR experience, with significant experience in strategic HR business partnering.
* Strong HRBP experience in ITES, BPO, or large-scale service-oriented organizations.
* **Demonstrated success in attrition management, employee retention, and workforce stabilization**
  , preferably in high-volume operational environments.
* Proven ability to analyse attrition trends, identify root causes, and implement measurable retention improvement initiatives.
* Experience partnering with senior leadership and managing complex employee relations matters.
* Demonstrated expertise in performance management, talent management, employee engagement, workforce planning, and organizational development.
* Experience leading HR teams and driving organization-wide people initiatives.
* Strong understanding of HR policies, labour law compliance, and people management practices in a dynamic operational environment.

**Preferred Industry Background**

  **US Healthcare or Healthcare RCM industry is highly preferred**
  .
* Experience supporting large-scale ITES, BPO, shared services, or operations-driven organizations.
* Exposure to US healthcare operations, medical billing, or revenue cycle management environments will be an added advantage.
* Experience managing attrition and retention challenges in large employee populations, particularly in shift-based or customer-service-oriented operations.

Strategic HR Business Partnering

Attrition Control & Employee Retention

Workforce Stability & Retention Strategy

ITES / BPO / Shared Services HR

US Healthcare / Healthcare RCM

Employee Relations & Grievance Management

Employee Engagement & Experience

Workforce Planning & Organizational Development

Exit Analysis & Root Cause Analysis

Change Management

Leadership Coaching & Stakeholder Management

Organizational Effectiveness

description:
Management

Who we are?

**Job Description**
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for a detail-oriented and organized HR & Accounts Executive to manage employee administration, office operations, invoicing, GST coordination, and day-to-day financial documentation. The candidate will play an important role in ensuring smooth internal operations, maintaining accurate records, supporting statutory compliance, and coordinating with employees, vendors, clients, and external accountants.
  
  
This role requires someone comfortable handling multiple responsibilities in a growing startup environment.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Human Resources & Employee Management
* Maintain employee records, personnel files, attendance, leave balances, and employment documentation.
* Coordinate recruitment activities, including job postings, interview scheduling, candidate communication, and onboarding.
* Prepare and coordinate offer letters, appointment letters, internship letters, experience certificates, and relieving letters.
* Track employee attendance, working hours, leave requests, and monthly payroll inputs.
* Coordinate monthly payroll processing, salary documentation, reimbursements, and employee-related deductions.
* Maintain HR policies, employee handbooks, holiday calendars, and internal procedures.
* Support employee engagement, performance review coordination, and internal communications.
* Track probation periods, contract renewals, internship durations, and employee exits.
* Accounting & Bookkeeping
* Maintain day-to-day records of income, expenses, purchases, payments, and receipts.
* Record and organize financial transactions, invoices, receipts, and supporting documents.
* Maintain accounts payable and receivable records and track outstanding payments.
* Prepare expense statements, reimbursement summaries, and monthly financial reports.
* Reconcile bank statements with accounting records and identify discrepancies.
* Maintain vendor records, purchase orders, payment schedules, and expense documentation.
* Coordinate with the company's Chartered Accountant (CA) for bookkeeping reviews, financial statements, and statutory filings.
* Assist in preparing cash flow statements, budgets, and financial summaries for management.
* GST, Invoicing & Statutory Compliance
* Prepare and issue customer invoices, pro forma invoices, quotations, and payment receipts.
* Verify GST details, HSN/SAC classifications where applicable, tax rates, and invoice particulars in coordination with the CA.
* Maintain GST-compliant sales and purchase invoice records.
* Track GST collected, input tax credit documentation, and applicable tax payment requirements.
* Coordinate with the CA for GST return preparation, reconciliation, and timely filing.
* Track TDS applicability, deduction records, certificates, and filing requirements with the CA.
* Maintain statutory records and support compliance with applicable company, tax, and employment requirements.
* Monitor invoice due dates and follow up with customers for pending payments.
* Office Administration & Procurement
* Manage office supplies, stationery, pantry essentials, housekeeping requirements, and other administrative purchases.
* Monitor inventory levels and ensure timely replenishment of office materials.
* Coordinate vendor quotations, procurement, deliveries, bills, and payments.
* Maintain office assets, equipment registers, maintenance schedules, and allocation records.
* Coordinate office facilities, repairs, utilities, internet connectivity, and other service providers.
* Maintain an organized office environment and support day-to-day operational requirements.
* Ensure administrative expenses are documented and tracked against budgets.
* Grant & Project Financial Documentation
* Maintain project-wise expense records and supporting bills for grants, pilots, and funded programmes.
* Organize invoices, payment proofs, bank statements, and expense documentation for financial reporting.
* Assist in preparing utilization statements, statements of expenditure, and milestone-wise expense reports.
* Track approved budgets, actual expenditure, and available balances for individual projects.
* Coordinate with project teams and the CA to ensure expenses are properly documented and classified.
* Support financial audits, grant reviews, and requests for supporting documents from funding agencies.
* General Operations & Management Support
* Maintain organized digital and physical filing systems for HR, accounts, administration, and compliance records.
* Prepare internal trackers, spreadsheets, and management reports.
* Coordinate employee reimbursements, travel bookings, and administrative arrangements.
* Track recurring payments, subscriptions, office rent, utility bills, and vendor contracts.
* Support management with documentation for incubators, grant applications, audits, and other business requirements.
* Identify opportunities to improve internal processes and administrative efficiency.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Accounting, Business Administration, Human Resources, or a related discipline.
* Basic knowledge of bookkeeping, invoicing, GST, and financial documentation.
* Familiarity with HR administration, employee records, payroll coordination, and attendance management.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, and office productivity tools.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple responsibilities.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality when handling employee, salary, and financial information.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with accounting software such as Tally Prime, Zoho Books, or similar platforms.
* Familiarity with GST invoicing, GST reconciliation, TDS, and statutory compliance coordination.
* Experience with payroll processing and HR management tools.
* Understanding of vendor management, procurement, and office administration.
* Experience maintaining project budgets, grant expenses, or audit documentation.
* Prior experience in a startup, small business, or growing organization.

Key Competencies
  
  

* High attention to detail and accuracy.
* Strong coordination and time-management skills.
* Ownership of routine administrative and financial processes.
* Discretion and integrity in handling confidential information.
* Proactive problem-solving and follow-through.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate across teams.

What We Offer
  
  

* An opportunity to contribute to the growth of an emerging climate-tech startup.
* Exposure to HR, finance, accounting, and business operations.
* Opportunities to build and improve internal systems and processes.
* A collaborative working environment with exposure to startup operations and funded projects.

Performance Expectations
  
  
**Success In This Role Will Be Measured By**

* Accurate and up-to-date employee and financial records.
* Timely invoicing and systematic follow-up on outstanding payments.
* Timely coordination of payroll, GST, and other applicable compliance activities.
* Effective management of office supplies, vendors, and administrative expenses.
* Complete and audit-ready documentation for grant-funded projects.
* Reliable reporting and smooth day-to-day office operations.

title: Digital HR Product Analyst
description:
**Job Title: Digital HR Product Analyst**
**Career Level: C**
**Introduction To Role**
 Are you prepared to transform complex HR needs into clear, scalable digital solutions that power hiring and talent growth across a global enterprise? In this role, you will sit at the heart of how we evolve our Talent Acquisition and Talent Management products, ensuring every change is grounded in real user needs and delivers measurable outcomes for the business and, ultimately, for patients.
   

  

 You will be the first line of clarity for product demand, shaping ideas into actionable requirements and guiding them through delivery in collaboration with Product Managers, HRIT, process experts and technology vendors. Could you translate a flood of requests into a coherent, prioritised backlog that improves user journeys and accelerates our impact? With exposure to platforms such as Workday, Eightfold and specialist tools including HireVue, Radancy, LinkedIn and Fieldglass, you will help create a consistent and reliable experience for HR users worldwide.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
 Tickets and Demand Triaging: Bring structure to incoming queries, incidents, access requests and enhancement ideas by clarifying the problem, user groups, urgency and impact; route each item correctly and recommend whether it progresses, is redirected or addressed via guidance or training.
   

  

 Requirements and Impact Assessment: Convert validated needs into detailed problem statements, requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria; assess implications across processes, user journeys, data, integrations, access, privacy and security; identify gaps, dependencies and risks and involve specialists where required; maintain traceability from need to validation outcome.
   

  

 Maintain complete and auditable records in ServiceNow and other tools. De\-duplicate and link related items. Clarify readiness and provide evidence for prioritisation. Ensure ownership, next actions, and partner communications are clear. Monitor progress and raise blockers through governance.
   

  

 Evaluate options with HRIT and vendors based on original requirements and the broader product landscape. Coordinate business validation and end\-user testing, including scenarios, acceptance criteria, participation, results, and defect management. Confirm outcomes and ensure gaps are detailed and addressed. Support release readiness and change planning.
   

  

 Provide timely and transparent updates on status, decisions, and next steps. Explain product and technical details in accessible language. Set realistic expectations while building confidence that requests are understood and managed consistently.
   

  

 Collaboration and Portfolio Support: Build strong working relationships across product, process, HRIT and vendor teams; develop broad knowledge of the portfolio to provide flexible support across products as priorities shift; supply to team resilience through knowledge sharing, documentation and coverage.
   

  

**Essential Skills/Experience**
* Practical experience in product analysis, business analysis or HR technology, including requirements, demand assessment,or product support in an enterprise environment.
* Ability to investigate a business or user problem, ask thoughtful questions and translate collaborator input into clear, structured and proportionate requirements.
* Ability to assess scope, impact, priority, dependencies and risk, and to recognise when specialist product, process, technical or business input is needed.
* Experience supporting user acceptance testing, including defining scenarios and success criteria, engaging users, recording results, capturing defects and confirming whether a solution meets the intended outcome.
* Strong organisation and attention to detail, capable of handling multiple requests at different stages, maintaining accurate records and following through on agreed actions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including proficiency at explaining product or technical considerations in a clear, practical and accessible way.
* Effective relationship\-building skills and experience working collaboratively across business, product, process and technology teams.
* A curious, customer\-focused and practical outlook, with the rigor to ensure requests are accurately analysed and managed in a global, matrix environment.


**Desirable Skills/Experience**
* Experience with Workday and/or Eightfold or any other HR System
* Familiarity with Talent Acquisition or Talent Management technologies, including platforms similar to HireVue, Radancy, LinkedIn, or Fieldglass, is a plus
* Experience using ServiceNow or a comparable service\-management platform to track demand, manage workflows, maintain records and provide collaborator updates.
* AI and Digital Fluency, Demonstrable curiosity and confidence in using AI\-enabled tools to improve analysis, productivity and stakeholder support. Able to critically evaluate AI\-generated outputs, apply appropriate human judgement, and use AI responsibly in line with data privacy, security and organisational standards.
* Understanding of HR data, access, privacy, security and integration considerations within enterprise HR systems.
* Awareness of candidate, employee, recruiter and manager journeys, and how digital products support these user groups.
* Experience analysing product\-support trends, user feedback, adoption information or service data to identify insights and improvement opportunities.
* Experience working with collaborators across multiple countries, cultures and time zones.
* Familiarity with technology releases, vendor roadmaps and the evaluation of new product functionality.

title: Delivery Manager
description:

For the last 25 years, we've done exactly that by living our core values of putting people first, delivering excellence in all we do, and giving back to the communities in which we live and work. We are a leading workforce solutions company supporting the talent needs of global leaders in financial services, technology, communications, utilities, and transportation and we are one of the largest women and minority\-owned companies in our industry.  Recruiting \& Delivery Execution

 Qualifications:

* Contribuer à l’amélioration continue des processus de recrutement en identifiant des occasions d’optimisation et d’amélioration de l’expérience candidat.
* Soutenir les initiatives liées à la marque employeur Fujitsu

* Être basé(e) en Inde et être en mesure de travailler à distance.

title: HR Data Solutions Specialist
description:
**Job Title: HR Data Solutions Specialist**
**GCL: D3**
**Introduction To Role**
 Are you ready to turn governed HR data into decisions that shape a high\-performing, patient\-focused enterprise? This role is your opportunity to deliver trusted, secure and actionable workforce data that leaders rely on to make informed choices about how we attract, develop and support our people.
   

  

 Can you translate complex workforce data into clear, reusable data products that are easy to access and simple to trust? You will work at the intersection of HR, Reporting \& Analytics, IT and external partners to engineer data pipelines, strengthen controls and elevate data quality so that insights are reliable and timely.
   

  

 Your impact will span day\-to\-day continuous improvement and strategic events such as Mergers and Acquisitions. By improving data quality, access governance and AI stewardship, you will help ensure we use employee data responsibly, accelerate transformation and ultimately support the delivery of life\-changing medicines.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Data Product Analysis and Insight: Analyze HR Data Products and workforce data to identify trends, anomalies, data\-quality issues and opportunities for improvement, turning findings into prioritized actions that elevate decision\-making.
* Data Stewardship and Domain Expertise: Act as a domain expert for defined HR data areas, maintaining data definitions, business rules, relationships, ownership, metadata and lineage to ensure transparency and appropriate use.
* Requirements and Planning: Gather and document data requirements, business rules, user needs, acceptance criteria and expected outcomes; support planning, prioritization, testing, release and collaborator communications to deliver the right solutions at the right time.
* Data Engineering and Pipelines: Develop, test, maintain and improve data pipelines and solutions in line with standards; perform data cleansing, transformation, mapping, validation and reconciliation to ensure robustness and reusability.
* Data Quality Management: Identify data\-quality issues, investigate root causes and coordinate corrective actions; apply data testing, reconciliation, documentation and control practices to sustain high data standards.
* Access Governance and Security: Support access governance for confidential and sensitive HR data, aligning with policies and controls; reinforce role\-based access and least\-privilege principles to protect privacy and ensure compliance.
* Reporting and Insights Delivery: Support the delivery of workforce reports, dashboards and insights using approved enterprise technologies, ensuring outputs are accurate, timely and aligned to collaborator needs.
* Mergers, Acquisitions and Change: Prepare and validate HR data for M\&A, system changes and interpersonal initiatives; complete data loads using approved templates, perform pre\- and post\-load checks, and investigate exceptions, advancing when appropriate.
* AI Governance and Responsible Use: Give to AI governance activities, ensuring appropriate data use, access, privacy, risk management and human oversight across analytics involving employee data.
* Ways of Working and Teamwork: Partner with HR, People Services, Reporting \& Analytics, IT, vendors and business collaborators; work through structured requirements, backlogs and Agile methods; promote data\-driven decision\-making, open communication and continuous improvement.


**Essential Skills/Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Data Analytics, Data Management, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, or related field.
* Demonstrable experience in data analysis, data management, reporting, data governance, data engineering, HR technology, or related fields.
* Strong passion for data and a genuine interest in using data to improve business performance and workforce decisions.
* Experience with data cleansing, transformation, mapping, validation, reconciliation, and data\-quality assessment.
* Ability to analyze complex data sets, identify patterns and anomalies, investigate issues, and communicate findings clearly.
* Understanding data governance principles, including data ownership, data quality, access, privacy, metadata, and proper use of sensitive data.
* Experience chipping in to reports, dashboards, data products, or analytical solutions.
* Advanced spreadsheet capability, including data manipulation, formulas, lookups, pivot tables, and validation techniques.
* Understanding data models, relationships, definitions, business rules, and data flows.
* Understanding data pipelines and the data lifecycle, including ingestion, storage, transformation, preparation, and presentation.
* Ability to apply data testing, reconciliation, and quality assurance practices.
* Experience with, or proven interest in, automation, scripting, or programming for data analysis and process improvement.
* Understanding access governance concepts, including role\-based access and least\-privilege principles.
* Ability to work with structured requirements, defined work packages, backlogs, or Agile delivery methods.
* Strong customer orientation, communication skills, attention to detail, and logical problem\-solving ability.
* Ability to work independently and cross\-functionally across a global, matrixed and cross\-cultural organization.
* Proven initiative, accountability, learning agility, and willingness to develop new technical and HR data skills.


**Desirable Skills/Experience**
* Knowledge of HR data, workforce processes, or HR technology.
* Experience with HR functionality, data management, and business processes.
* Experience supporting HR data migration, system implementation, organizational change, Mergers and Acquisitions or workforce data integration.
* Experience with data visualization, business intelligence, or enterprise reporting technologies.
* Experience with SQL, Python, VBA, PowerShell or similar technologies.
* Exposure to cloud data platforms, data warehouses, lake houses, orchestration tools or enterprise data platforms.
* Experience developing, testing, deploying, or maintaining data pipelines and data applications.
* Exposure to DevOps or DataOps practices, including source control, automated testing, deployment automation, monitoring or release management.
* Experience using data catalogues, metadata repositories, business glossaries or lineage tools.
* Understanding data and application design patterns, APIs, integration patterns, or scalable data solutions.
* Experience supporting data access reviews, data stewardship, data\-quality frameworks, or broader data\-governance initiatives.
* Experience with AI governance, responsible AI, model governance or analytics involving employee data.
* Knowledge of data privacy principles, including privacy by design, data minimization, retention, and purpose limitation.
* Experience working in a global organization or with external vendors, consultancies and system implementation partners.
* Experience chipping in to Agile data, analytics, or technology delivery projects.
* Experience coordinating activities across multiple teams or supporting the development of colleagues.
* Awareness of data technology trends, industry practices and the external market for data and analytics solutions.


 When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash ambitious thinking with the power to inspire life\-changing medicines. In\-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and bold world.
   

  

**Why AstraZeneca**
 Here, your craft in data will power the enterprise that brings science to patients faster. You will partner with diverse authorities who flourish with collaboration, use brand new digital tools and value ethics and clarity in every decision. We bring people together in person to fuel bold ideas, move rapidly and do the right thing the right way, while valuing kindness alongside ambition. Your work will connect directly to outcomes that matter: improving how we plan, develop and care for our global workforce, so we can deliver life\-changing medicines to those who need them.
   

  

 If you are ready to build trusted HR data products that leaders rely on and elevate your impact in a fast\-moving, supportive environment, take this step and shape the future with us.
   

  

**Date Posted**
 16\-Sept\-2026
   

  

**Closing Date**
 08\-Oct\-2026
   

  

 AstraZeneca embraces diversity and equality of opportunity. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team representing all backgrounds, with as wide a range of perspectives as possible, and harnessing industry\-leading skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We welcome and consider applications to join our team from all qualified candidates, regardless of their characteristics. We comply with all applicable laws and regulations on non\-discrimination in employment (and recruitment), as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements.

 The Systems Analyst, IT\-HR analyzes HR business problems to be solved with SAP SuccessFactors and related HRIS systems. The individual executes unit, integration, and acceptance testing for SuccessFactors modules and assists in creating specifications for system enhancements to meet business requirements.

 Every Day At Hubbell Is Different, And You’ll Contribute In Many Ways. On Any Given Day, You’ll Make a Difference By

* Experience with system testing, validation, and user training

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**The Vacancy** 




  





 GB Global is the UK’s leading independent logistics and global trade management provider, employing over 1,000 colleagues across a diverse network of operational, logistics, warehousing and commercial locations.
 



  





 As our Chennai business continues to grow, we are looking for an ambitious, commercially minded HR professional to join the team and help strengthen local people support.
 



  





 This is a strong opportunity for an experienced HR Business Partner, Senior HR Adviser or aspiring HR Manager who is ready to take the next step. The successful candidate will lead day\-to\-day employee relations activity, support wider ER initiatives, and contribute to organisational change projects across the business.
 



  





 The role will be based predominantly in Chennai, with regular travel to other business locations as required. This will give the successful candidate the opportunity to build strong working relationships, understand GB Global operations first\-hand, and provide practical HR support across the business.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  




* Lead complex employee relations casework, including disciplinary, grievance, capability, absence management and appeal matters.
* Provide practical, commercially focused HR advice to senior operational leaders, balancing business needs with fair, consistent and compliant people practices.
* Coach and support managers to build confidence in handling people matters and improving day\-to\-day management capability.
* Support Organisational change, restructuring and consultation processes, ensuring clear communication, appropriate documentation and effective risk management.
* Identify, assess and mitigate employment risks while ensuring compliance with employment legislation, company policies and internal procedures.
* Keep HR policies, procedures and templates up to date, ensuring they remain legally compliant, operationally relevant and clearly understood by managers and employees.
* Use HR data, trends and management information to support decision\-making, identify recurring issues and drive continuous improvement.
* Partner with managers on recruitment activity, including understanding resourcing requirements, supporting selection processes and helping to deliver a positive candidate experience.
* Work closely with outsourced payroll providers to maintain accurate employee data, support timely payroll processing and resolve payroll queries efficiently.
* Contribute to the development of the wider Employee Relations function by improving processes, sharing best practice and supporting consistent standards across the business.



  





**What We're Looking For:** 




  




* Proven experience in an HR Business Partner, Senior HR Adviser or HR Manager role.
* Strong employee relations knowledge, with the confidence to manage complex and sensitive people matters.
* Good working knowledge of employment law and HR best practice, with the judgement to know when to escalate risk.
* Experience supporting operational, logistics, warehousing or other fast\-paced environments would be advantageous.
* Commercially aware, pragmatic and confident working with managers to find practical solutions.
* Strong communication, influencing and stakeholder management skills.
* Comfortable using HR data and systems to support accurate records, reporting and decision\-making.
* Relevant HR qualification, such as CIPD Level 5 or equivalent, or able to demonstrate equivalent practical experience.
* Flexible and willing to travel to other business locations when required.



  





**What We Offer:** 




  




* A genuine opportunity to shape the HR support model for a growing Chennai operation.
* Exposure to a varied employee relations workload, Organisational change activity and operational leadership teams.
* The chance to work in a commercially focused environment where HR has a clear role in supporting business performance.



  





 This is a hands\-on HR Manager role for someone who enjoys working close to the business, providing practical employee relations support and helping managers make confident people decisions. The successful candidate will play an important part in supporting the continued growth of the Chennai operation, while contributing to a consistent, commercially focused HR approach across GB Global.

description:
