 Standardise HR practices across the corporate office, regions and showrooms.
 



 Prepare the annual HR operations plan and budget.
 



**Employee Lifecycle Management** 




 Oversee all employee processes from joining through separation.
 



 Ensure timely completion of appointment letters, confirmations, transfers, promotions, increments and relieving documents.
 



 Monitor probation and confirmation schedules.
 



 Ensure accurate documentation for employee movements and status changes.
 



 Coordinate smooth onboarding and exit\-clearance processes.
 



**HR Policies and SOPs** 




 Develop, review and update HR policies in consultation with the CHRO and management.
 



 Communicate HR policies clearly across all locations.
 



 Ensure uniform interpretation and implementation of policies.
 



 Maintain proper approval controls and policy documentation.
 



 Conduct periodic policy\-awareness programmes.
 



**Attendance, Leave and Workforce Administration** 




 Control attendance, leave, shift, weekly\-off and holiday\-management processes.
 



 Ensure attendance is closed accurately and submitted to Payroll within the defined timeline.
 



 Monitor late attendance, absenteeism, unauthorised leave and excessive overtime.
 



 Ensure showroom duty rosters comply with business and legal requirements.
 



 Resolve attendance and leave discrepancies promptly.
 



**Payroll Coordination** 




 Provide verified employee data and attendance inputs to the Payroll team.
 



 Validate new joiners, exits, salary revisions, incentives, recoveries and deductions.
 



 Ensure payroll inputs are accurate and submitted according to schedule.
 



 Review payroll exceptions and resolve employee salary concerns.
 



 Maintain maker\-checker and approval controls for all payroll\-related changes.
 



**HRMS and Employee Records** 




 Ensure the HRMS contains complete and accurate employee information.
 



 Lead HR process automation and digitisation initiatives.
 



 Maintain employee personal files, service records and statutory documents.
 



 Control access to confidential employee information.
 



 Conduct regular HRMS and employee\-file audits.
 



 Generate reliable HR data and reports for management decisions.
 



**Regional and Showroom HR Operations** 




 Guide Regional HR Managers and showroom HR representatives.
 



 Ensure HR policies and processes are followed consistently across all locations.
 



 Conduct periodic HR operational audits of regions and showrooms.
 



 Resolve escalated employee and manager queries.
 



 Support new\-showroom openings, employee transfers and workforce deployment.
 



**Employee Relations and Grievances** 




 Establish a structured employee grievance\-resolution process.
 



 Ensure employee complaints are acknowledged, investigated and closed within defined timelines.
 



 Support disciplinary enquiries and corrective\-action processes.
 



 Guide regional and functional managers in handling employee issues.
 



 Maintain confidentiality and fairness in all employee\-related matters.
 



 Coordinate with the Employee Relations or Legal team when necessary.
 



**Statutory Compliance and Audit Support** 




 Coordinate compliance relating to employment records, working hours, leave, notices and statutory registers.
 



 Work with the Compliance, Payroll and Legal teams on labour\-law requirements.
 



 Ensure timely closure of HR audit observations.
 



 Provide employee documents and records during internal, statutory and management audits.
 



 Monitor compliance requirements across different states.
 



**Separation and Full\-and\-Final Settlement** 




 Ensure resignations and terminations follow the approved process and delegation of authority.
 



 Monitor notice periods, handover, clearances and recovery of company assets.
 



 Coordinate timely full\-and\-final settlements with Payroll and Finance.
 



 Ensure relieving and experience letters are issued after completing all requirements.
 



 Conduct exit interviews and analyse reasons for attrition.
 



 Recommend corrective action to improve employee retention.
 



**HR Budget and Vendor Management** 




 Prepare and monitor the HR operations budget.
 



 Manage HR vendors such as background\-verification agencies, HRMS providers, manpower contractors and documentation services.
 



 Evaluate vendor performance, service quality and cost efficiency.
 



 Ensure proper agreements, approvals and invoice verification.
 



**HR MIS and Management Reporting** 




 Prepare weekly and monthly HR dashboards for the CHRO and management.
 



 Report employee strength, vacancies, joining, exits, transfers, absenteeism and attrition.
 



 Track regional and department\-wise employee costs.
 



 Analyse HR trends and highlight risks requiring management attention.
 



 Maintain a single, reliable source of employee data.
 



**Team Leadership** 




 Lead HR Operations Managers, Deputy Managers, Assistant Managers and Executives.
 



 Define team responsibilities, service\-level standards and performance targets.
 



 Review team productivity and quality of work.
 



 Train team members on HR policies, HRMS, documentation and compliance.
 



 Develop suitable successors for key HR operations positions.
 



  





**Qualification and Experience** 




 MBA/PGDM in Human Resources or an equivalent qualification.
 



 Approximately 15–20 years of HR experience, including at least 5 years in a senior HR operations role.
 



 Experience in large retail, jewellery, FMCG or other multi\-location organisations is preferred.
 



 Strong knowledge of HR operations, HRMS, labour compliance, payroll coordination and employee relations.

title: Workday Techno Functional Consultant
description:
**About Poshmark**
**Poshmark is the leading fashion marketplace where style comes alive through discovery, self\-expression, and human connection.** 
 Powered by a vibrant community of 165 million members, Poshmark brings real people and taste to shopping through a social experience shaped by shared discovery. Buying and selling fashion feels simple, joyful, and personal, while every item tells its own story. Poshmark empowers sellers to grow meaningful businesses, keeps fashion in circulation longer, and gives shoppers access to unique and trusted finds, from everyday pieces to one\-of\-a\-kind vintage and luxury.
   

  

 We are seeking a highly skilled and analytically driven
 **Senior Specialist II, HR Technology** 
 (Workday Techno\-functional consultant) to join our People team. In this role, you will serve as a senior subject matter expert at the intersection of HR systems and people analytics, helping to optimize our HR technology ecosystem while enabling data\-driven decision\-making across the organization.
   

  

 While you will bring deep expertise in Workday HCM—our current HR platform—your value extends beyond any single tool. You are an HR technology and people analytics professional who can build scalable reporting and analytics solutions, support workforce planning through data\-driven insights, and translate complex workforce data into actionable recommendations for HR and business leaders. You contribute to the development of analytics frameworks and predictive analyses while helping ensure that our people data ecosystem remains scalable, reliable, and adaptable as technology evolves.
   

  

 You will partner closely with HR, IT, Finance, and business stakeholders to enhance system capabilities, improve data quality, streamline processes, and deliver meaningful workforce insights that support organizational goals.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* People Analytics \& Workforce Insights
* Develop and maintain workforce dashboards, scorecards, and recurring reports that support HR and business decision\-making.
* Analyze workforce trends across headcount, attrition, recruiting, diversity, performance, engagement, and employee lifecycle metrics.
* Partner with HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards, and business leaders to understand reporting needs and provide actionable insights.
* Build and maintain data visualizations using tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Workday Prism Analytics, or equivalent platforms.
* Support workforce planning, talent reviews, succession planning, and organizational effectiveness initiatives through data analysis and reporting.
* Contribute to the development of people analytics frameworks and predictive analyses that support talent and workforce decisions.
* Ensure consistency, accuracy, and integrity of workforce metrics by adhering to established reporting standards and governance practices.
* HR Systems Administration (Workday)
* Administer, configure, and maintain Workday HCM modules including Core HR, Recruiting, Talent Management, Compensation, Benefits, Time \& Absence, and Helpdesk.
* Configure and support business processes, workflows, notifications, security roles, and system controls in alignment with HR policies and operational requirements.
* Develop and maintain Workday reports, dashboards, calculated fields, and composite reports.
* Support Workday biannual releases by assessing impacts, testing enhancements, and coordinating deployment activities.
* Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve system issues while ensuring timely communication and resolution for stakeholders.
* Partner with HR Operations and IT teams to continuously optimize system functionality, user experience, and process efficiency.
* HR Data Governance \& Quality
* Maintain high standards of HR data accuracy, completeness, and consistency across HR systems.
* Conduct regular audits and validation activities to identify and resolve data discrepancies.
* Support compliance with internal controls, audit requirements, and applicable data privacy regulations.
* Document reporting definitions, system configurations, business processes, and operating procedures.
* Contribute to the ongoing development and maintenance of HR data governance standards and data quality processes.
* Support efforts to improve trust, transparency, and accessibility of people data across the organization.
* Systems Integration \& Technical Support
* Support integrations between Workday and connected systems including payroll, benefits, talent, learning, and finance platforms.
* Assist with data imports, exports, Enterprise Interface Builder (EIB) processes, and interface monitoring activities.
* Partner with IT teams and external vendors to troubleshoot integration issues and implement system enhancements.
* Participate in testing activities for integrations, system upgrades, new functionality, and process changes.
* Maintain technical documentation, configuration records, and knowledge base materials to support operational continuity.
* Process Optimization \& Stakeholder Enablement
* Identify opportunities to automate manual HR processes and improve operational efficiency through technology solutions.
* Gather business requirements and translate them into scalable system configurations, reports, and process improvements.
* Serve as a trusted resource for HR technology questions, providing guidance and support to stakeholders across the organization.
* Deliver training, user documentation, and knowledge\-sharing sessions to improve system adoption and proficiency.
* Participate in HR technology projects, implementations, and continuous improvement initiatives from planning through execution.
* Build strong partnerships with HR, IT, Finance, and business teams to ensure technology solutions align with organizational needs.


**Qualifications**
**Experience**
* 7\+ years of experience in HR Technology, HRIS, People Analytics, or related functions within complex and growing organizations.
* Hands\-on experience administering and configuring Workday HCM, including Core HR, Recruiting, Talent Management, Compensation, Benefits, Time \& Absence, and related modules.
* Proven experience developing HR reporting, dashboards, workforce analytics, and data\-driven insights that support business and talent decisions.
* Experience supporting HR system implementations, enhancements, testing, upgrades, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Experience working with HR system integrations, data management processes, and vendor\-supported technology solutions.
* Demonstrated ability to independently manage complex projects and deliver technical solutions while effectively partnering with cross\-functional stakeholders.


**Analytics \& Technical Skills**
* Strong proficiency in Workday Report Writer, calculated fields, dashboards, and reporting capabilities.
* Experience with data visualization platforms such as Tableau, Power BI, Workday Prism Analytics, or equivalent tools.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to interpret workforce data and communicate findings effectively.
* Working knowledge of SQL and data querying concepts; familiarity with Python or R is a plus.
* Understanding of system integration concepts including APIs, EIBs, SFTP, and data transformation processes.
* Knowledge of HR data structures, reporting methodologies, and data governance best practices.


**Domain \& Compliance Knowledge**
* Strong understanding of core HR processes and employee lifecycle management.
* Knowledge of compensation, recruiting, talent management, workforce planning, and organizational effectiveness concepts.
* Understanding of HR data privacy, security, and compliance requirements including GDPR, CCPA, and applicable local regulations.
* Familiarity with global HR operations and governance practices is preferred.


**Soft Skills \& Ways Of Working**
* Strong customer\-service orientation with a commitment to delivering high\-quality stakeholder support.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts into business\-friendly language.
* Detail\-oriented with a strong focus on accuracy, data quality, and process discipline.
* Highly organized and capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Collaborative team player who builds productive partnerships across functions and levels.
* Demonstrates initiative, ownership, continuous learning, and a passion for process improvement.


**What Success Looks Like**
 In your first year, you will establish yourself as a trusted HR technology and people analytics partner across the organization. Stakeholders will rely on your expertise to deliver accurate workforce insights, maintain reliable HR systems, and identify opportunities for process improvement. Reporting capabilities will become more efficient and scalable, data quality will improve, and HR teams will have greater confidence in leveraging technology and analytics to make informed decisions. Through your contributions, the HR technology ecosystem will be better optimized, more user\-friendly, and well\-positioned to support the organization's growth and evolving business needs.
   

  

**A Note on Tooling**
 We currently use Workday as our primary HRIS, and deep Workday expertise is required for this role. However, we value professionals whose strengths extend beyond any single platform. Success in this role requires strong capabilities in HR technology, people analytics, workforce reporting, and process optimization that can adapt as systems and business needs evolve over time.

title: Lead - Franchise Operations and Retail Expansion
description:
**About This Job**
**Pickyourtrail**
**Location:** 
 Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India
   

  

**Work Mode:** 
 On\-site
   

  

**Industry:** 
 Travel Arrangements,Retail
   

  

**Job Description**
 About the Role:
   

  

 We operate on a FOFO (Franchise\-Owned, Franchise\-Operated) model, where the success
   

  

 of each store depends heavily on the quality, ownership mindset, and operating capability of
   

  

 the franchise partner.
   

  

 We are looking for a hands\-on operator to own the performance and expansion of this
   

  

 network.
   

  

 This is not a role for someone who wants to manage the business primarily through
   

  

 dashboards and reviews. You will spend significant time in stores, with franchise partners,
   

  

 understanding ground realities, solving operational problems, and building repeatable
   

  

 systems that make our best stores the benchmark for the network.
   

  

**What You’ll Own**
* Store hiring – Hiring is the store partner's own KPI, not yours — but you’ll actively guide


 and support them in hiring the right type of people, with a repeatable toolkit and tighter
   

  

 handoff into our training team.
   

  

* Sales attrition – Also the store partner's KPI. You'll help them diagnose root causes and


 adopt a retention playbook (comp, incentives, career path) rather than owning the
   

  

 outcome directly.
   

  

* Local demand generation – Reduce over\-reliance on centrally\-sourced paid leads by


 building partners' capability to generate local demand (referrals, local tie\-ups,
   

  

 community/corporate outreach).
   

  

* Lead economics \& conversion – Fix cases where partners consume paid leads (50%


 CAC\-charged post month 6\) without converting — via better training, accountability, or
   

  

 lead\-routing fixes.
   

  

* Partner selection \& store health – Sharpen partner vetting toward operators over


 investors; run a regular store review cadence; drive real turnarounds for
   

  

 underperforming stores.
   

  

* Playbook codification – Turn what works in our best stores into a standard playbook for


 new and struggling ones.
   

  

* New store expansion – Scout markets and real estate (500\-600 sq ft,


 high\-street/arterial\- road, high\-visibility), and screen partners rigorously — at the pace
   

  

 needed to hit 20\-25 stores without a quality drop.
   

  

* Leading the Store Ops team – Hire, coach, and manage this team directly. They train


 store staff and resolve tickets (itinerary, pricing, deal support) — conversion stays with
   

  

 the store seller/partner. Set standards for response time, quality, and scale the team as
   

  

 stores grow.
   

  

* Stakeholder management – Work across performance marketing, training, and finance


 to translate store\-level reality into action, and vice versa.
   

  

* Commercial \& compliance ownership – Own franchise LOB budgeting/forecasting,


 track unit economics (CAC vs. revenue by store), and keep franchise agreements
   

  

 compliant.
   

  

**What Does Success Looks Like**
* Underperforming stores show measurable turnaround, or an honest call on the partner


 relationship
   

  

* Documented hiring/onboarding process adopted across most stores; attrition trending


 down
   

  

* Growing share of revenue from partner\-generated local demand
* Store\-level lead\-conversion economics visibly improving, not just tracked
* 11 20\-25 stores in 12 months, without quality drop in stores or partners→ Store Ops


 team scales with store growth, holding response quality steady
   

  

**What’s Needed**
 Non\-negotiables
   

  

* Stakeholder management\- credible with founders, partners, and internal teams at once
* Managing by influence — formal authority over Store Ops only; store partners must be


 moved through relationship and credibility, not hierarchy
   

  

* Problem\-solving — root\-cause diagnosis, comfortable building the playbook where


 none exists
   

  

* Go\-getter mindset, hustle, and a willingness to get hands dirty — in stores, not just on


 dashboards
   

  

* Based in Chennai, in person


**Preferred**
* Retail operations or multi\-location/franchise management background — ground\-level,


 revenue\-owning, not purely strategic/advisory
   

  

* Experience managing a hire\-train\-retain cycle for a distributed frontline team
* Direct people\-management experience
* Comfort with franchise\-model messiness — variable partner capability, local market


 variance
   

  

* P\&L / unit\-economics fluency
* MBA preferred, min 5 years of prior work experience


 Nice to have
   

  

* Travel, hospitality, or similar high\-consideration sales category experience
* Experience scaling a partner/franchise network from a smaller base

title: Functional Consultant-D365 HR
description:
Are you a passionate and enthusiastic Dynamics 365 HR professional looking to build your career in HR digital transformation and enterprise application consulting?
 



 Join LevelShift as a
 **Functional Consultant – Dynamics 365 HR** 
 , where you'll help organizations streamline and transform their HR processes by implementing and optimizing Microsoft Dynamics 365 Human Resources. You'll collaborate with HR stakeholders, business users, technical teams, and solution architects to understand existing HR processes, perform fit\-gap analysis, and deliver scalable HR solutions.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




 As a
 **Functional Consultant – Dynamics 365 HR** 
 at LevelShift, you will:
 


* Engage with HR stakeholders and business users to understand existing HR processes, business requirements, and system challenges.
* Conduct requirement gathering, process analysis, and fit\-gap analysis to identify the best Dynamics 365 HR solutions.
* Analyze existing Workday or other HR systems and map their functionality and processes to Dynamics 365 Human Resources.
* Configure and implement Dynamics 365 HR functionalities based on business requirements and functional design.
* Prepare business requirement documents, functional design documents, process flows, user stories, and other functional documentation.
* Support HR system migration, including data mapping, data migration, validation, and reconciliation.
* Collaborate with technical teams on integrations and the transition of functionality from legacy or third\-party HR applications.
* Work closely with HR stakeholders, business users, architects, and project teams throughout the implementation lifecycle.
* Support SIT, UAT, testing, defect management, end\-user training, deployment, and post\-implementation activities.
* Identify opportunities to consolidate existing HR applications, optimize business processes, and introduce automation using Dynamics 365 HR.



  





**How This Role Uses AI** 



* Should be comfortable using AI tools to enhance consulting workflows, automate repetitive tasks, generate business insights, and improve productivity while ensuring solution quality and governance.
* Utilize AI\-assisted requirement analysis, process documentation, process mapping, testing, and workflow automation to improve project delivery efficiency.
* Leverage AI\-powered tools such as Microsoft Copilot, Dynamics 365 Copilot, Power Platform Copilot, GitHub Copilot, and Microsoft Fabric AI capabilities to support documentation, analysis, automation, testing, and HR process optimization.
* Explore opportunities to use AI capabilities to improve HR operations, automate routine processes, and provide actionable business insights.



  





**Your Skillset** 



* 5\+ years of experience in functional consulting and solution delivery, with strong expertise in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Human Resources.
* Strong hands\-on experience in configuring and implementing Dynamics 365 Human Resources functionalities based on business requirements.
* Strong understanding of core HR processes and employee lifecycle management.
* Experience in requirement gathering, business process analysis, fit\-gap analysis, and functional solution design.
* Ability to work directly with HR and business stakeholders to understand requirements and recommend appropriate Dynamics 365 HR solutions.
* Experience in preparing functional documentation, including BRD, FDD, process flows, user stories, and functional specifications.
* Hands\-on experience with HR system migration, data mapping, data validation, and transitioning functionality from legacy or third\-party applications.
* Understanding of system integrations and collaboration with technical teams to support HR application integrations.
* Experience in SIT, UAT, testing, defect management, user training, and deployment activities.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to work independently, collaborate with distributed teams, and drive activities from requirements through implementation.
* Passion for continuous learning and staying current with Dynamics 365, Power Platform, AI, and Microsoft ecosystem innovations.



  





**Why LevelShift?** 



* Accelerate your career growth by working on impactful HR digital transformation and enterprise application initiatives.
* Gain hands\-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Human Resources, Power Platform, AI, and modern business application technologies.
* Learn from experienced consultants, architects, and technology leaders in a collaborative environment.
* Work alongside cross\-functional teams that value innovation, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement.
* Solve real\-world HR and business challenges by delivering scalable solutions that improve processes and operational efficiency.
* Access continuous learning opportunities, certification support, professional development programs, and exposure to emerging AI\-powered business applications.

**Who We Are**
 Glencore is one of the world’s largest global diversified natural resource companies and a major producer and marketer of more than 60 commodities that advance everyday life. Through a network of assets, customers and suppliers that spans the globe, we produce, process, recycle, source, market and distribute the commodities that support decarbonisation while meeting the energy needs of today.
   

  

 With over 150,000 employees and contractors and a strong footprint in over 35 countries in both established and emerging regions for natural resources, our marketing and industrial activities are supported by a global network of more than 50 offices.
   

  

 Glencore’s customers are industrial consumers, such as those in the automotive, steel, power generation, battery manufacturing and oil sectors. We also provide financing, logistics and other services to producers and consumers of commodities.
   

  

 Glencore is proud to be a member of the Voluntary Principles on Security and Human Rights and the International Council on Mining and Metals. We are an active participant in the Extractive Industries Transparency Initiative.
   

  

 We will support the global effort to achieve the goals of the Paris Agreement through our efforts to decarbonise our own operational footprint. We believe that we should take a holistic approach and have considered our commitment through the lens of our global industrial emissions. Against a restated 2019 baseline, we are targeting to reduce our Scope 1, 2 and 3 industrial emissions by 15% by the end of 2026, 25% by the end of 2030, 50% by the end of 2035 and we have an ambition to achieve net zero industrial emissions by the end of 2050, subject to a supportive policy environment. For more information see our 2024\-2026 Climate Action Transition Plan and the About our emissions calculation and reporting section in our 2023 Annual Report, available on our website at glencore.com/publications.

 ,
 **bot\-enabled**

 solutions.
 



 Our platform is designed for digital operations—trusted by governments, Fortune 500 companies, and high\-growth enterprises alike.
 



 If you’re looking to be part of a company that combines innovation, global exposure, and a mission to disrupt legacy systems with intelligent enterprise applications
 **Ramco is the place to be.** 




  





**ROLE OVERVIEW** 




 The
 **Manager / Senior Manager – Payroll Bureau** 
 oversees payroll compliance across a region or multiple countries, leading a team to ensure accurate, timely, and high\-quality statutory compliance within the payroll product.
 



 The role is pivotal in strengthening compliance governance, driving statutory development cycles, and enabling scalable, standardised processes across countries.
 



 The individual is the primary owner of compliance delivery for assigned regions — representing the compliance function to internal and external stakeholders, holding service quality, and building a culture of accountability, accuracy, and continuous improvement.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**Regional Compliance Ownership \& Governance** 



* Lead compliance operations across the assigned region and ensure full statutory coverage in the payroll product.
* Ensure end\-to\-end statutory updates —
 **monitoring, interpretation, communication, development, testing, release** 
 — are executed with precision and timeliness.
* Act as the escalation point for complex compliance interpretations, exceptions, and regulatory disputes.
* Own relationships with authorities, consultants, and regulatory bodies for assigned geographies.
* Build compliance governance frameworks, SOPs, and audit\-ready documentation standards.



**Regulatory Interpretation \& Technical Oversight** 



* Review product requirements, interpretation notes, change impact assessments, and compliance documentation prepared by the team.
* Guide the team on complex multi\-country regulatory analysis and accurate statutory interpretation.
* Evaluate regulatory changes for business impact, system updates, and operational feasibility.
* Provide clear guidance on ambiguous legal scenarios and edge cases.



**Leadership, Team Management \& Capability Building** 



* Lead the team with effective workload allocation, quality checks, and timely delivery.
* Mentor, coach, and upskill team members through structured training, feedback, and development plans.
* Drive a culture of accuracy, ownership, accountability, and excellence in interpretation and documentation.
* Conduct performance evaluations, workforce planning, and capability development initiatives.



**Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Customer Confidence** 



* Partner with Product Engineering and other cross\-functional teams to ensure accurate and timely implementation of regulatory requirements in the product.
* Lead end\-to\-end review of existing statutory setups for critical countries and implement product enhancements.
* Ensure timely, clear communication of regulatory changes to internal and external stakeholders.
* Oversee responses to complex customer compliance queries, ensuring accuracy, logical reasoning, and consistency.
* Represent Payroll Bureau in customer meetings and compliance deep\-dives, building credible relationships with clients, consultants, and internal partners.



**Strategic Initiatives \& Innovation** 



* Lead initiatives to scale compliance operations through automation, templates, frameworks, and standardised processes.
* Partner with technology teams on AI\-driven compliance research tools, dashboards, analytics, and automation projects.
* Build compliance assets including whitepapers, statutory summaries, and marketing and thought\-leadership content.
* Identify and implement opportunities for continuous improvement, standardisation, and future\-readiness.



**Training \& Knowledge Enablement** 



* Drive internal and external training programmes on payroll compliance, regulatory frameworks, and statutory updates.
* Strengthen organisation\-wide compliance capability through structured enablement sessions.



**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE** 



* Full statutory coverage for the region, delivered ahead of regulatory effective dates.
* Complex interpretations and disputes resolved at this level rather than escalated upward.
* A team whose documentation needs progressively less correction.
* Customers and consultants who trust the Bureau’s statutory position without needing to verify it.
* Compliance operations that scale through standardisation rather than added headcount.



  





**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIS)** 




*Performance in this role is measured against the following indicators. Targets are set annually with the Head – Payroll Bureau and reviewed on the cadence noted.* 



* **Statutory coverage and release timeliness** 
 — statutory updates for the region delivered into the product ahead of their effective dates, with full coverage maintained.
 *(Per release)*
* **Compliance accuracy** 
 — statutory defects reaching production for the region, and defects traced to an interpretation error.
 *(Per release)*
* **Governance and escalation** 
 — frameworks, SOPs, and documentation standards current and audit\-ready; complex interpretations, exceptions, and regulatory disputes resolved within the agreed timeline.
 *(Quarterly)*
* **Technical review quality** 
 — team documentation reviewed and signed off, and rework arising after sign\-off.
 *(Monthly)*
* **Team capability and performance** 
 — performance evaluations and development plans completed, and capability gaps closed against plan.
 *(Half\-yearly)*
* **Customer and stakeholder confidence** 
 — complex compliance queries resolved accurately within the agreed window, and customer deep\-dives supported to a satisfactory outcome.
 *(Quarterly)*
* **Scale and enablement** 
 — automation, template, or framework initiatives delivered, and training programmes and compliance assets published against plan.
 *(Half\-yearly)*



**REQUIRED EXPERIENCE \& SKILLS** 



* Qualified
 **Chartered Accountant, Company Secretary, or Lawyer** 
 with 7 to 10 years of relevant payroll compliance experience, or another qualification with 10\+ years in multi\-country payroll or statutory compliance roles.
* Experience in team leadership, stakeholder engagement, and managing multi\-country compliance.
* Strong analytical, logical, and interpretation skills.
* Ability to simplify complex regulations into clear, implementable guidance.
* Excellent written and verbal communication.
* High integrity, professionalism, and ownership, with pride in the quality of work and curiosity to keep learning.
* Builds strong working relationships within and across teams, and coaches team members to succeed through guidance and clarity.
* Adapts quickly to changing demands and shifting priorities, and takes ownership to deliver solutions.
* Builds trust with internal teams, customers, and external partners, and gives them confidence through clear communication of statutory coverage in the product.
* Brings structure and strategic thinking to compliance operations, and continuously improves processes.



**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** 



* Knowledge of Ramco tools is an added advantage.
* Experience owning authority and regulator relationships in more than one jurisdiction.
* Exposure to compliance automation, analytics dashboards, or AI\-assisted regulatory research tooling.



**WHY JOIN RAMCO SYSTEMS** 



* Own payroll compliance for a full region on a platform used across 35\+ countries.
* Direct influence on how regulation is built into the product.
* Lead a compliance team and represent the function to clients and regulators.
* Be part of a fast\-evolving, innovation\-led enterprise software company.

title: Assistant Manager Human Resources
description:
About the Role
 



 We're looking for a Senior HR Manager who has lived inside a high\-volume retail or QSR environment and knows what it takes to keep dozens of stores fully staffed, well\-trained and motivated. This is a hands\-on, build\-and\-scale role, not a maintenance one. You'll own the full people lifecycle for our frontline and store\-management teams across three cities, and you'll be the person who makes sure our headcount keeps pace with our store rollout without sacrificing quality of hire.
 



 You'll partner directly with the MD, cluster managers and the training function, and you'll bring the systems, discipline and energy needed to run HR at scale across a distributed network.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



**Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Planning** 



* Own high\-volume recruitment for store crew, shift leads and store managers across all three cities, building a pipeline that stays ahead of the store\-opening calendar.
* Build and maintain a sourcing engine (referrals, hyperlocal channels, institutes, gig platforms) that fills frontline roles fast and at the right cost\-per\-hire.
* Forecast manpower needs against the expansion plan and new\-store launch timelines.



**Retention \& Engagement** 



* Tackle frontline attrition head\-on — diagnose root causes, design interventions, and bring measurable improvement to retention and tenure.
* Run engagement, recognition and feedback mechanisms suited to a young, distributed, shift\-based workforce.



**Performance, Training \& Development** 



* Partner with the Head of Training to ensure every new hire moves through structured onboarding and sign\-off gates before going live on the floor.
* Drive a clear performance\-management rhythm across stores, including goal\-setting, reviews and career pathing for high performers.



**HR Operations \& Compliance** 



* Own statutory and labour\-law compliance across all locations — Shops \& Establishments, PF, ESI, minimum wages, contract labour and store\-level documentation.
* Standardise HR processes, policies, SOPs and the HRIS so the system scales cleanly as store count grows.
* Manage payroll inputs, attendance discipline, grievance handling and disciplinary processes fairly and consistently.



**Franchise \& Multi\-City Support** 



* Define people standards, hiring frameworks and training expectations that franchise partners adopt to keep service quality consistent network\-wide.
* Act as the central HR point of contact for cluster managers in Chennai, Bangalore and Hyderabad.



 What We're Looking For
 


* 8\+ years in HR, with at least 4 in a senior role within QSR, food \& beverage retail, organised retail or a multi\-outlet chain.
* Proven track record managing high\-volume frontline recruitment and reducing attrition in a shift\-based workforce.
* Strong working knowledge of Indian labour law and multi\-state statutory compliance.
* Experience standing up HR systems and processes in a scaling business — not just running an established one.
* Comfortable operating across multiple cities and stores, with willingness to travel.
* Hands\-on, founder\-mindset operator who can both set strategy and get into the detail.
* Fluency in English and Tamil; conversational Kannada and/or Telugu is a strong plus.
* MBA/PGDM in HR or equivalent preferred.

title: Head of Talent Management
description:
Position Title: Talent Management \& Organizational Effectiveness
 



 Reporting To: Head HR NTBI
 



 Location: Chennai
 



  





**Role Purpose (Why this role exists)** 




 To architect and drive NTBI's integrated talent strategy, ensuring that performance, potential, and culture are not siloed but fused into a cohesive engine that fuels business agility. This role is tasked with moving beyond traditional HR metrics to create a self\-sustaining talent ecosystem that anticipates future skill demands, de\-risks leadership pipelines, and embeds inclusion into the organizational DNA.
 



  





**Core Scope of Accountability** 




**1\. Performance Management \-** 
**From Evaluation to Enablement** 



* Implement the annual performance cycle into a continuous, real\-time feedback culture rather than a once\-a\-year compliance event.
* Drive the Goal Cascade across NTBI, ensuring every individual goal connects vertically to business strategy and horizontally to cross\-functional alignment.
* Implement Quality\-Adjusted Performance metrics... ensuring that output is measured not just by "what" but "how," integrating behavioral competencies and values.
* Lead the VC / Variable Pay calibration process, ensuring objective, fair, and defensible pay\-for\-performance decisions.



  





**2\. Succession \& HiPo Management** 
 \-
 **Building the Leadership Bench** 



* Develop and sustain a robust, data\-driven Succession Pipeline for all critical roles .
* Identify and nurture High\-Potential (HiPo) talent through structured interventions, not just assessments, but targeted developmental rotations, mentoring, and exposure.
* Create a "Ready\-Now" vs. "Future\-Ready" succession dashboard, ensuring the organization never operates with a single point of failure.
* Partner with business heads to de\-risk leadership continuity, especially in high\-impact engineering and R\&D functions.



  





**3\. Learning \& Development (L\&D) \- Future\-Skilling at Scale** 



* Shift L\&D from a "training calendar" to a capability / skills\-led transformation engine, focusing on future\-critical capabilities
* Design a skills taxonomy for NTBI in line with Nissan, mapping current vs. desired skills across the organization and driving targeted upskilling/reskilling interventions.
* Establish measurable L\&D ROI, linking learning completion to business outcomes (productivity, error reduction, innovation output).
* Drive certification partnerships with leading institutes and platforms to build technical and leadership depth.



  





**4\. Career Architecture \- Clarity, Mobility \& Growth** 



* Redesign the career framework, moving away from linear promotions to a multi\-dimensional career lattice that offers lateral moves, cross\-functional exposure, and skills\-based progression.
* Champion Internal Mobility \& IJP as a cultural norm, not an exception, ensuring that employees see growth pathways within NTBI rather than outside.
* Develop clear career pathways for high\-demand roles with transparent competency expectations at each level.



  





**5\. DEI – Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion (Embedded, Not Add\-On)** 



* Shift DEI from a "check\-the\-box" metric to a business imperative—ensuring diversity in pipelines (campus hiring, laterals, leadership succession).
* Drive inclusive leadership by embedding DEI principles into performance assessments, hiring panels, and promotion decisions.
* Establish measurable DEI KPIs, gender parity at leadership levels, representation of underrepresented groups in STEM roles, and equitable pay analytics.
* Partner with Communications to tell authentic DEI stories that strengthen employer branding.



  





**6\. Culture \& Employee Experience \- The Invisible Force** 



* Design and drive Culture Roadmap for NTBI, ensuring values are not posters but lived behaviors.
* Lead the Employee Engagement / Pulse Survey strategy (including GES integration) and, more importantly, close the loop on Action Planning.
* Institutionalize continuous listening mechanisms, stay interviews, exit insights, and AI\-driven sentiment analysis, to proactively address friction points.
* Embed psychological safety and psychological ownership as measurable cultural outcomes.



**7\. Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Planning \- Strategic Sourcing to Onboarding** 



* Lead
 **end\-to\-end talent acquisition strategy** 
 , from demand forecasting to sourcing, selection, and onboarding, ensuring alignment with business growth and skill requirements.
* Drive
 **workforce planning** 
 in partnership with Finance and BU heads, translating business strategy into a forward\-looking talent demand map (GETs, laterals, leadership hires).
* Design and execute a
 **multi\-channel sourcing strategy** 
 , campus hiring (IITs/NITs/top engineering colleges), lateral hiring, niche skill acquisition (EV, ADAS, AI/ML, software\-defined vehicles), and executive search.
* Own the
 **employer branding** 
 narrative, positioning NTBI as an employer of choice in the automotive and technology ecosystem, both domestically and globally.
* Build a robust
 **intern\-to\-GET pipeline** 
 , ensuring seamless conversion and reducing time\-to\-productivity for fresh talent.
* Establish and track
 **TA metrics** 
 . Cost per Hire, Time to Fill, Quality of Hire, Offer Acceptance Rate, Diversity Sourcing and drive continuous improvement.
* Partner with the C\&B team on
 **competitive benchmarking** 
 to ensure offers are market\-competitive and defensible.
* Ensure a
 **world\-class candidate experience** 
 , from application to onboarding, that reflects NTBI's culture and values.



  





 Professional Qualifications
 


* **Education.** 
 MBA from a top\-tier B\-School / PG in HR from a recognized institution
* **Experience.** 
 14\-20 years in Talent Management / OD / HR Business Partnering, with at least 5 years in a leadership role
* **Industry Preference.** 
 Automotive / Engineering / Technology / Manufacturing preferred
* **Expertise.**

title: Head of Human Resources & Administration
description:
**Company Overview:** 




 IRISS is the global leader in industrial safety and condition\-based monitoring technologies, trusted by power generation, data center, and critical infrastructure teams worldwide. We design and manufacture in our facility in Bradenton Florida (made in the USA) innovative solutions that make maintenance safer, smarter, and more connected — helping organizations prevent failure, reduce risk, and protect their people.
 



 IRISS has its headquarters in the U.S. with operations across LATAM, EMEA, APAC, and India. At our core is a simple idea with profound impact: We Humanize Safety. That means creating products and technologies that are not only advanced, but intuitive, empowering, and designed with people in mind.
 



 We’re shaping the future of how industries work — and how workers stay safe
 



  





***Please review our website and YouTube to learn more about our products and who we are:***




  





**Electrical Maintenance Safety Solutions \| IRISS Inc** 




 https://iriss.com/
 



**IRISS \- YouTube** 




 https://www.youtube.com/@Irissemsd
 



  





**Position Overview** 




 We are seeking an experienced HR leader to manage Human Resources, Industrial Relations, Compliance, and Administration for our India operations. The role will oversee workforce planning, recruitment, employee engagement, statutory compliance, performance management, and office/facility administration across both manufacturing and commercial functions.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 · Lead end\-to\-end recruitment for manufacturing, Production Supervisors, Operators, Technicians, Sales Managers, Regional Sales Engineers.
 



 · Establish HR policies, processes, and systems for India operations.
 



 · Ensure compliance with all applicable labour laws and statutory requirements.
 



 · Manage employee relations, disciplinary matters, grievance handling, and industrial relations.
 



 · Drive performance management, training, employee engagement, and organizational development initiatives.
 



 · Oversee payroll inputs, employee records, and HR documentation.
 



 · Manage administration, facilities, security, housekeeping, and vendor contracts for Chennai and Bangalore locations.
 



 · Partner with leadership on workforce planning, succession planning, and organizational growth.
 



 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
 



 · Timely closure of approved positions.
 



 · Annual employee attrition within target levels.
 



 · 100% statutory compliance and timely filings.
 



 · Zero major compliance violations or labour disputes.
 



 · Successful implementation of performance management processes.
 



 · Employee engagement and retention targets achieved.
 



 · Administration and facility budgets maintained within approved limits.
 



  





**Qualifications** 




 · MBA/PGDM in HR, Personnel Management, Labour Welfare, or equivalent.
 



 · 12\+ years of HR experience, including experience in manufacturing organizations.
 



 · Strong knowledge of labour laws, factory compliance, and industrial relations.
 



 · Experience supporting both factory and sales/commercial teams preferred.
 



 · Experience in setting up HR processes for a growing organization is highly desirable.
 



  





**What We Offer** 




 · Opportunity to build and lead the HR function for India /APAC operations.
 



 · Strategic leadership role with exposure to global management.
 



 · Dynamic and growth\-oriented work environment.
